name: @guardbee/mcp-security-proxy
description: Security proxy for MCP servers — intercepts tool calls, detects prompt injection, masks PII, and writes audit logs
long_description: Sits between an MCP client and another MCP server, wrapping its tool calls: detects and can block prompt injection attempts, masks PII in tool inputs/outputs, and writes an audit log of every intercepted call. Unlike GuardBee's other servers, this one does not expose its own fixed tool set — it forwards (and can transform) whichever tools the wrapped server provides. Requires the command to launch the wrapped server (proxyCommand/proxyArgs), not an API key.

proxyCommand.title: Wrapped Server Command
proxyCommand.description: The command to run the MCP server you want to wrap (e.g. 'npx').
